docs.title: Simsapa Dhamma Reader
docs.text:
A sutta reader and Pāli dictionary application. Feature highlights:

  • Fulltext search with Pāli declension matching
  • Suttas, commentaries, dictionaries and a book library
  • Search result filtering options
  • Reading layout: line-by-line or side-by-side columns with multiple translations
  • Pāli text gloss analysis with export formats
  • Extensions and plugins for browsers and note taking app
  • Command line interface (@simsapa/cli npm package) for humans and AI agents

Download from the Releases page for Linux, MacOS, Windows. For Android, install from from the Play Store or using the .apk download.

On the first run, it downloads the application database and fulltext index. After the database download, the application works offline.

Installation guides: Linux / MacOS / Windows.

docs.title: Privacy Policy for Simsapa
docs.text:
Last updated: 25 July 2026

Simsapa is a sutta reader and Pāli dictionary application. This policy explains what data the application sends over the network, why, and how you can turn it off.

Summary: Simsapa does not require an account, does not ask for your name or email, and does not use advertising, analytics SDKs, or tracking cookies. After the initial download of the sutta and dictionary databases, the application can be used entirely offline. The only regular network request is an update check, which can be disabled.

docs.title: 1. Who we are
docs.text:
Simsapa is a free and open-source project. In this policy, "we" refers to the maintainers of the Simsapa application.

  • Contact details are published at: https://gambhiro.github.io/
  • Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/simsapa/simsapa

docs.title: 2. Data stored on your device
docs.text:
Your reading activity is not tracked and user-created data such as bookmarks stay on your device. This includes:

  • The sutta and dictionary databases downloaded on first start
  • Bookmarks, search history, and any other content you create
  • Application settings and preferences

We do not have access to any of this. It is not uploaded to us or to anyone else, and it is not backed up to any server. If you uninstall the application, this data is removed along with it (subject to your operating system's own backup behaviour, which is outside our control).

docs.title: 3. Data downloaded on first start
docs.text: When you first run Simsapa, it downloads the sutta and dictionary databases it needs to function. These are ordinary file downloads from https://github.com/simsapa/simsapa-assets/releases. No personal information is sent.

docs.title: 4. The update check
docs.text:
On launch, Simsapa requests a JSON listing of available updates from:

https://simsapa.eu.pythonanywhere.com/releases

The purpose is to tell you when a newer version is available for your system and app version.

docs.title: 4.1 What is sent
docs.text:
The request includes the following technical parameters:

Parameter Description Example channel Release channel selected in the app main, development app_version Version of the installed application 1.0.2 system Operating system linux, windows, macos, android, ios machine CPU architecture x86_64, aarch64 cpu_max Maximum CPU frequency in MHz 3600 cpu_cores Number of CPU cores 8 mem_total Total system memory in bytes 16777216000 screen Screen resolution 1920 x 1080 no_stats Whether the request should be saved true, false

The request does not include your name, email address, phone number, contacts, location, advertising identifier, device serial number, IMEI, MAC address, or any of your reading data, bookmarks, notes, or search terms.

docs.title: 4.2 Device identification and Google Play
docs.text: Simsapa does not generate or transmit a persistent device identifier. However, the combination of hardware characteristics listed above, together with the IP address inherent to any internet request (see section 5), could in principle be used to distinguish one device from another. Because Google Play's disclosure rules are based on what data could identify a device rather than on our intent, we have declared "Device or other IDs" as collected in the Google Play Data safety section.

docs.title: 4.3 Opt-out setting
docs.text:
The "Settings window > Updates > Notify About Simsapa Updates" option can be disabled to turn off checking for updates completely.

The "Settings window > Updates > Don't send stats" option disables sending the technical parameters.

Both options are found in the application settings. Disabling the update check means you will need to check for new versions yourself.

docs.title: 5. Server logs
docs.text:
The update endpoint is hosted on PythonAnywhere. As with any web request, the hosting provider's web server records standard log information, including your IP address, the time of the request, and the user agent string.

See also: PythonAnywhere privacy policy.

An IP address is treated as personal data under the GDPR, which is why we mention it explicitly here. If you would prefer that your IP address never reaches our server, disable the update check.

docs.title: 6. Encryption
docs.text: All network requests made by the application use HTTPS, so the data described above is encrypted in transit.

docs.title: 7. Sharing
docs.text:
We do not sell, rent, or trade any data. We do not share data with advertisers, data brokers, or analytics companies. The only third parties involved are the infrastructure providers needed to deliver the service:

  • PythonAnywhere: hosts the update endpoint
  • GitHub: hosts the source code, release files, and this page

docs.title: 8. Your rights
docs.text:
Depending on where you live, you may have rights under the GDPR, the UK GDPR, the CCPA, or similar laws — including the right to access, correct, or delete personal data held about you, and to object to its processing.

Because we do not collect names, email addresses, accounts, or persistent identifiers, we are generally unable to locate data relating to a specific person. The most direct way to exercise control is to disable the update check and statistics in the application settings.

Under the GDPR, our legal basis for the update check is legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) — providing security and compatibility updates and maintaining the application on the platforms our users actually run.

docs.title: 9. Children
docs.text: Simsapa is not directed at children and does not knowingly collect personal information from children. The application contains no advertising, no user accounts, and no social or messaging features.

docs.title: 10. Changes to this policy
docs.text: We may update this policy as the application changes. The revised version will be published at this URL with an updated date at the top. Material changes will also be noted in the application's release notes.

docs.title: 11. Contact
docs.text: Questions about this policy can be sent to the contact address at https://gambhiro.github.io/, or raised as an issue at https://github.com/simsapa/simsapa/issues.

docs.title: Gloss Tab
docs.text:
Select a passage in the reader panel and click the Gloss icon:

The default is two rows per word but there is an option for a one row layout. The previous more simple “Headwords” layout can be toggled.

It exports to a number of formats such as DOCX. The same glossing task can be done with the simsapa CLI as well.

docs.title: CLI with Agents
docs.text:
An npm package provides cli interface to Simsapa for humans and AI agents, which uses the same database as the GUI app.

npm install -g @simsapa/cli

More info: Command Line and Localhost API

docs.title: Dictionary Import
docs.text: In Windows > Dictionaries additional dictionaries can be imported. The selections automate importing from digitalpalidictionary/other-dictionaries, but custom StarDict / GoldenDict format .zip dictionary files can also be imported.

docs.title: Simsapa Command Line and Localhost API
docs.text:
An npm package provides cli interface to Simsapa for humans and AI agents, which uses the same database as the GUI app.

npm install -g @simsapa/cli
  • simsapa health checks status.
  • simsapa install-skill sets up skill files so agents know how to use it.
  • See simsapa help for more.

It reads API keys from env variables e.g. GEMINI_API_KEY

A glossing task as a cli command which saves the results to a DOCX file:

simsapa gloss \
        --model-name gemini-3.6-flash \
        --skip-common \
        --no-duplicates-globally \
        --no-translate \
        --format docx \
        --output gloss-dhp44-45.docx \
"Ko imaṁ pathaviṁ vicessati,
Yamalokañca imaṁ sadevakaṁ;
Ko dhammapadaṁ sudesitaṁ,
Kusalo pupphamiva pacessati.

Sekho pathaviṁ vicessati,
Yamalokañca imaṁ sadevakaṁ;
Sekho dhammapadaṁ sudesitaṁ,
Kusalo pupphamiva pacessati."

When the skill files are installed with simsapa install-skill, agents such as opencode.ai can perform tasks and include quotes and references from the database instead of being hallucinated.

Use the simsapa cli to find the Vinaya protocols related to Kathina privileges,
create a PDF document with typst including quotes and uid text references.

docs.title: Search Help
docs.text: Use the search bar to look in the Suttas (S), Dictionary (D) or Library (L) areas. Choose the area with the S / D / L buttons, then pick a search mode from the dropdown.

docs.title: Search modes
docs.text:
Sutta references are matched first. Typing mn8, sn 56.11, iti92 will list those suttas.

  • Fulltext Match -- word-based full-text search over the whole text. Pāli words are stemmed, so a query matches its inflected forms. Best for finding a word anywhere in the texts.
  • Contains Match -- literal substring match. Finds the exact letters you typed, wherever they occur.
  • Title Match -- matches only the titles of suttas or books.
  • Combined (Dictionary) -- runs a DPD lookup together with the word deconstructor, the most helpful default for dictionary searches.
  • DPD Lookup -- looks up headwords and roots in the Digital Pāḷi Dictionary.
  • Headword Match -- matches dictionary headwords.

docs.title: Fulltext Search Examples
docs.text:
The fulltext search uses tantivy's query syntax. The 'must' (+) and 'negative' (-) terms are particulary useful for filtering results.

Words don't have to be exactly near each other, e.g. so ce evam vadeyya will also find so ce bhikkhu evaṁ vadeyya

Prefixing a term with + and - can control "Must" or "Must not" include.

santam padam abhisamecca -- each term may be included, but ok if not all are found.

santam padam +abhisamecca -- 'abhisamecca' must be included, even if the others may be absent.

santam padam -abhisamecca -- 'abhisamecca' must not be included.

Fulltext matches Pāli declensions but doesn't do partial word matches, so upasan doesn't find anything (not a valid declension stem) until you type upasankama.

The Contains Match is for exact partial matches.

docs.title: Typing a query
docs.text:
• Search-as-you-type runs a plain text query once it is 4 or more characters long; a recognised reference such as mn8 runs from 3. This way, short text queries which would match too many results are held back while you type.
  • Press the search button (or the Enter key) to run a query without waiting: a 3-character query runs straight away, while a 1- or 2-character query first asks you to confirm, because it can return many results.
  • In the Dictionary area, a one- or two-letter word such as i or ko can be looked up as a dictionary id by using the /dpd form (i/dpd, ko/dpd). Confirming the short-query prompt does this for you.

docs.title: References open directly
docs.text:
• A sutta reference such as SN 56.11, Dhp 183 or a book uid such as bmc.0 opens that text.
  • A dictionary reference such as dhamma 1.01, 34626/dpd or dhamma-1-01/dpd opens that entry.

docs.title: Language filter
docs.text: The language dropdown limits results to one language. Language (the first option) means no filter -- results from all languages are shown.

docs.text:

docs.title: Install on Linux
docs.text:
Download the latest .AppImage from Releases.

Move it to a convenient folder and add executable permissions to the .AppImage file.

chmod +x *.AppImage

After the database downloads are completed, and the app is re-started, Simsapa creates a .desktop app launcher, and it can be started from the menu.

The default location of the app launcher is: ~/.local/share/applications/simsapa.desktop

If you encouter errors, see the Troubleshooting > Linux page first.

docs.title: Install on MacOS
docs.text:
Download the latest .dmg from Releases.

Open the .dmg file, drag the Simsapa icon to Applications.

When starting the app, you will see a warning because the app is not signed, and MacOS can't verify the developer.

Allow apps from third-party locations:

Open System Preferences > Security & Privacy > scroll down and click "Open Anyway"

Next to the message "Simsapa" was blocked ..., click Open Anyway.

Starting the app with the icon will ask again:

docs.text:
Github: simsapa/simsapa-extensions-and-plugins

docs.title: Install the Chrome plugin
docs.text:
The Chrome plugin is not yet published in the web store.

  • Download simsapa-chrome.zip
  • Extract to a folder
  • Open Menu > Extensions > Manage Extensions (chrome://extensions/)
  • Enable Developer mode in the top-right corner
  • Click Load unpacked, open the extracted extension folder
  • The extension is now installed
  • (📙 NOTE: Deleting the folder also removes the extension)

docs.title: Portable Use
docs.text: Simsapa can be used as a portable application, e.g. running it from a USB drive or a user folder.

docs.title: Windows setup
docs.text:
The Windows setup offers a "Portable mode", where the application is installed in a folder you choose.

Even when planning to use if from an external drive later, it is faster to install to a folder on the Desktop first and selecting the .cmd launcher option, then starting the app so that it downloads and extracts the databases there.

When the setup completes, move the files to the USB drive (Simsapa/ and SimsapaData/ folders and the Simsapa.cmd launcher).

A flash USB stick can work but a bit slow due to read speed of the flash memory. An SSD or NVMe type drive is recommended for good performance.

There are more technical details in the application docs. It can be helpful to copy the docs link in an AI chat and ask how to set it up for your situation.

docs.title: General
docs.text:
Create a config.txt or .env file in the same folder as the executable binary.

The SIMSAPA_DIR=path/to/simsapa-dir variable specifies the folder where the app should look for the database and other assets.

If this is folder is on a USB, the drive letter has to be updated when a different machine assign a different drive letter.

SIMSAPA_DIR=E:\SimsapaData

If the assets are found in that folder, the Sutta Search window will open.

If the assets are not found, they will be downloaded to the specified folder.

docs.title: Uninstall
docs.text:
MacOS: Select the application icon and move it to the Bin.

Windows: Delete the application folder and desktop icon.

Linux: Delete the .AppImage file and .desktop launcher.

docs.title: Removing the Application Database
docs.text:
When using the Windows uninstaller, it asks whether to also remove the application database (where the suttas, dictionaries, etc. are stored).

On every platform, the App Settings window has a button for Remove App Database and Assets...

Or manually, use the file manager or terminal to remove the applications local data folder:

MacOS:

rm -r ~/Library/Application\ Support/simsapa

Windows:

rmdir /s /q C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\profound-labs\simsapa

Linux:

rm -r ~/.local/share/simsapa

docs.title: Install on Windows
docs.text:
Download the latest Windows .exe from Releases.

When starting the setup, you will see a warning because the app is not signed, and Windows can't verify the developer.

Click "More info"

Click "Run Anyway"

After the setup completes, start the application. When running it the first time, it offers to download the database.

docs.title: App starts, but HTML content pages are blank
docs.text:
Start Simsapa with the following env variable:

QTWEBENGINE_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 ./Simsapa-v1.3.1-Linux-x86_64.AppImage

docs.title: Could not load the Qt platform plugin "xcb" in "" even though it was found
docs.text:
Install libxcb:

sudo apt install libxcb-cursor0

docs.title: Failed to load module 'xapp-gtk3-module'
docs.text: sudo apt install libxapp1

docs.title: The Wayland connection broke. Did the Wayland compositor die?
docs.text:
Open the app launcher file:

gedit ~/.local/share/applications/simsapa.desktop

On the Exec line insert QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb before the AppImage path, see the example below.

(📙 NOTE: replace /fullpath/to/ with the actual path and the app filename to the correct version)

[Desktop Entry]
Encoding=UTF-8
Name=Simsapa
Icon=simsapa
Terminal=false
Type=Application
Path=/fullpath/to
Exec=env QTWEBENGINE_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb /fullpath/to/Simsapa-v1.3.1-Linux-x86_64.AppImage
